messages:
alex.kim: hey folks - quick access question for my first week. I need to run a smoke on console staging and flip a feature flag for an integration test. Who grants staging console roles? :wave:
jen: welcome @alex! you need the 'console-staging-admin' role. ping infra-ops to approve, or I can fast-track if it's for onboarding. what's your email?
alex.kim: alex.kim@redwood.com
jen: ok sent a request to infra-ops. also add a note: 'access for integration smoke test - onboarding week1'
infra-ops: got it. will add you to group 'console-admins-staging' for 72h. you should get an invite in ~15m. :lock:
alex.kim: thanks! what about feature flags - can I toggle 'payments.beta_ui' in staging?
devon: depends - if it's behind a rollout we prefer a canary via flag gateway. If it's only a local test, you can toggle in console but please tag your change with the ticket number. if you want to script it, example curl:
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags/toggle 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"flag":"payments.beta_ui","value":true}'
```
alex.kim: what's the ticket? do I need a JIRA?
jen: please open a quick ticket titled 'ENG-ONBOARD: staging flag toggle' with env, flag name, reason, and test plan. attach screenshots if you can.
onboarding-bot: welcome @alex! required onboarding checklist: console staging access, dev cluster kubeconfig, jira access. Link: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding :tada:
alex.kim: got the invite, can see the staging workspace, but when I try to open /admin/features I get 403 (Forbidden)
sre-bot: 403 usually means not in 'console-feature-editors' group. infra-ops to confirm - audit logs should show the deny.
infra-ops: updated your groups - give it 5m for cache TTL. try again and post the exact error if still blocked.
alex.kim: ok refreshed, now I can see feature flags, can toggle in UI. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
jen: left a note on your onboarding doc to remind you to rotate keys after tests.
devon: one more thing: if you're scripting toggles use an api token with scope 'flags:write' and include audit header 'X-Operator' so we log who made the change. avoid using personal long-lived tokens for CI.
alex.kim: doing that now. can confirm toggled and ran the smoke tests. no regressions. closing ticket ENG-ONBOARD-1284.
jen: nice! drop a quick note in #product-team so PMs know the test ran.
alex.kim: will do. thanks again everyone :)
